name: Morning Systems Health Check
description: Daily morning health check for tech operations teams. Reviews overnight incidents and alerts, produces a structured health status report, and identifies items requiring immediate attention before the daily standup.

input_parameters.label: Systems in Scope
input_parameters.placeholder: e.g., Payment API, Auth Service, Data Pipeline, Core DB

input_parameters.label: Overnight Events / Alerts
input_parameters.placeholder: Paste overnight monitoring alerts, on-call log entries, or system events. Include: timestamp, system, event type, severity, and current status.

steps.label: Analyse Overnight Events
steps.description: ANTON analyses overnight alerts and events to identify incidents, patterns, and priority issues.

config.promptTemplate:
Analyse overnight system events for {{check_date}} across: {{systems_monitored}}.

Events:
{{overnight_events}}

Produce:
1. System health summary (Green/Amber/Red per system)
2. Incidents requiring immediate action (P1/P2)
3. Incidents being monitored (P3/P4 — no immediate action)
4. Resolved incidents (closed overnight)
5. Patterns or trends worth noting
6. Recommended first actions for the morning

steps.label: On-Call Engineer Review
steps.description: Review the health analysis, add context from direct system access, and decide on escalations.

config.checkpointMessage: Review the overnight health analysis. Confirm system statuses, add any context from direct monitoring access, and decide on escalations.

inputFields.label: Status corrections or additional context
inputFields.placeholder: Any corrections to ANTON's analysis, additional context from live system checks, or items ANTON missed...

inputFields.label: Escalations required
inputFields.placeholder: List any items that need to be escalated immediately and to whom. Leave blank if no escalations needed.

steps.label: Generate Standup Health Brief
steps.description: ANTON produces the morning health brief for the team standup and stakeholder notification.
